title: Supersonic flashing blue at filter cage
shortDescription: Filter cage clogged or improperly seated.
fullDescription:
The Supersonic dryer flashes blue at the bottom of the handle when the filter cage detects restricted airflow or is loose. The motor will throttle to protect itself.

Clean the filter mesh with the supplied brush and reseat it firmly until you hear a click.

fixSteps.title: Slide off filter cage
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the filter cage downward off the handle base.

fixSteps.title: Brush the mesh
fixSteps.instruction: Use the supplied cleaning brush in the rotating direction to lift lint.

fixSteps.title: Reseat the cage
fixSteps.instruction: Twist clockwise until it locks. The light should turn solid white when running.

whenToCallPro: If the light flashes after a thorough clean, contact Dyson — motor may be failing.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Supersonic flashing blue filter clean

faq.q: How often should I clean it?
faq.a: Monthly with daily use, or whenever the blue flash appears.
No — only brush it. Water damages the mesh adhesive.

title: Supersonic flashing red — overheating
fullDescription:
A red flash at the heat-setting LEDs indicates the dryer's NTC thermistor saw an over-temperature condition. Common causes are blocked filter, blocked nozzle attachment, or use at high altitude.

Unplug, wait 10 minutes, clean the filter, then retry.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter and attachment
fixSteps.instruction: Brush filter cage; rinse attachments under warm water and air-dry fully.

fixSteps.title: Test on cool
fixSteps.instruction: Run on cool airflow first; then bring heat up gradually.

whenToCallPro: If red flash returns within minutes of a clean restart.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Supersonic flashing red overheat fix

faq.q: Is it safe to keep using?
faq.a: No — the thermal cutout is protecting the motor. Address the cause first.

title: Airwrap won't recognise barrel/brush
shortDescription: Magnetic Coanda attachment not seating on the spindle.
fullDescription:
Airwrap detects attachments via magnetic Hall sensor at the barrel collar. If the attachment is not pushed fully home, or hair product has bridged the magnet ring, the wand throttles to safe airflow only and the heat lights stay off.

Wipe the magnetic ring and reseat firmly.

fixSteps.title: Wipe contact ring
fixSteps.instruction: Use a microfibre with isopropyl on the silver ring of the wand and the barrel base.

fixSteps.title: Reseat attachment
fixSteps.instruction: Push attachment on until it clicks audibly.

fixSteps.title: Try a different attachment
fixSteps.instruction: If second attachment also fails, wand sensor is at fault.

whenToCallPro: If multiple attachments fail to register, the wand needs Dyson service.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Airwrap attachment not detected fix

faq.q: Are HS01 and HS05 attachments interchangeable?
faq.a: Mostly yes — but the new long-barrel uses a slightly different lock.

title: Airwrap completely dead
shortDescription: No LEDs, no airflow when trigger pressed.
fullDescription:
The Airwrap uses a thermal fuse near the brushless motor. A clogged filter slowly blowing the fuse, or a damaged power cord at the strain relief, are the two most common causes of total power loss.

Try a known-good outlet, then inspect the cord at the wand entry.

fixSteps.title: Try another outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug into a non-GFCI outlet on a different circuit.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cord
fixSteps.instruction: Bend the cord 360° at the wand entry — look for kinks or exposed copper.

fixSteps.title: Contact Dyson
fixSteps.instruction: Cord and fuse are not user-serviceable; book service if cord checks bad.

whenToCallPro: Always — internal repair voids warranty if attempted.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Airwrap won't turn on cord

faq.a: Yes — flat-fee repair around USD 200 in most regions.

title: Corrale battery fault
shortDescription: Cordless straightener battery cell out of spec.
fullDescription:
Corrale flashes amber on the battery indicator if any of the four lithium cells reads outside its allowed voltage band. Most often this is a deeply discharged battery — leave it on the dock for 4 hours undisturbed.

If the flash returns after a full charge, the cell pack is failing.

fixSteps.title: Warm to room temp
fixSteps.instruction: If recently in checked luggage, let device sit at room temperature 1 hour.

fixSteps.title: Full charge
fixSteps.instruction: Place on dock 70 minutes — must show all four white bars.

fixSteps.title: Calibrate
fixSteps.instruction: Run device in cordless until it cuts out, then full charge once more.

whenToCallPro: Battery pack must be replaced by Dyson — non-user-serviceable.

faq.a: Yes — Corrale falls back to corded mode when battery is bad.

title: Corrale flexing plates seized
shortDescription: Manganese-copper plates not pivoting around hair.
fullDescription:
The Corrale's signature flexing plates pivot on a small leaf spring. Hair product buildup in the hinge or a bent leaf spring can lock plates flat, causing snags and uneven heat.

Clean the hinge and inspect the spring.

fixSteps.title: Clean hinge
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe hinge area with damp microfibre while warm (not hot).

fixSteps.title: Test flex
fixSteps.instruction: Gently press plates closed — they should give 2-3mm.

fixSteps.title: Service if rigid
fixSteps.instruction: If still locked, leaf spring needs Dyson replacement.

whenToCallPro: If plates are visibly bent or hinge cracked.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Corrale plates not flexing fix

faq.a: They distribute force across the hair section so each strand sees the same heat.

title: Airstrait won't enter wet mode
fullDescription:
Airstrait detects whether hair is wet via a moisture sensor on the inner plate. Limescale or product on the sensor pad makes it always read dry, locking out the higher 140°C wet preset.

Descale the plate area with vinegar dampened cloth.

fixSteps.title: Wipe plates
fixSteps.instruction: Use 50/50 white vinegar and water on a microfibre — do not soak.

fixSteps.title: Dry and test
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe dry, then run hand under wet hair section to confirm 140°C unlocks.

whenToCallPro: If wet mode still locked after cleaning.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Airstrait wet mode not working

faq.a: Yes — dry mode runs at 110°C with reduced airflow.

title: Supersonic motor weak
shortDescription: Motor running but airflow noticeably weaker.
fullDescription:
The V9 digital motor in Supersonic is rated 110,000 rpm. If airflow drops without the blue flash trigger, the impeller may have hairs wound on the shaft from a missing filter cage moment.

Dyson service can disassemble; user attempts will permanently unbalance the rotor.

fixSteps.title: Deep-clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Brush filter cage thoroughly; if heavily clogged, replace.

fixSteps.title: Listen for grind
fixSteps.instruction: If you hear scraping or chirping, motor is mechanically damaged.

fixSteps.title: Service request
fixSteps.instruction: Book Dyson repair — motor swap or replacement unit.

whenToCallPro: Any motor noise change.

faq.a: No — sealed and balanced at factory; opening voids any service eligibility.

title: Airwrap barrel won't reverse
shortDescription: Direction switch on barrel collar stuck.
fullDescription:
Long curling barrels have a sliding collar that selects clockwise or counter-clockwise Coanda jets. The slider becomes gummed with product and stops mid-travel — the wand only sees the last detent.

Clean under warm running water with the attachment removed from the wand.

fixSteps.title: Rinse slider
fixSteps.instruction: Hold barrel base under warm tap, working slider through full travel 20 times.

fixSteps.title: Air-dry overnight
fixSteps.instruction: Stand vertically. Do not use until completely dry.

whenToCallPro: If detent never returns after drying.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Airwrap barrel direction stuck clean

faq.a: The attachment alone, yes — never the wand body.

title: Supersonic stays in cool mode
fullDescription:
The cool-shot button sits below the heat selector. Hair product running down the body settles in the button gap and prevents the contact from releasing — the dryer treats it as a perpetual press.

Clean around the button and free the plunger.

fixSteps.title: Press repeatedly
fixSteps.instruction: Click the cool-shot button 20 times to break up residue.

fixSteps.title: Wipe gap
fixSteps.instruction: Use a wooden toothpick wrapped in microfibre dampened with isopropyl.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm heat returns when button released.

whenToCallPro: If button stays depressed mechanically after cleaning.
videoSearchQuery: Dyson Supersonic cool shot stuck button

faq.a: Avoid soaking — the dryer is not water-resistant.
